messages:
alex: deploy-bot alerted a 2.1% p50 error-rate regress on dedicated pool us-west-2 for model redwood-v2-custom. rolling canary at 10% traffic started 2001234500. should we auto-revert or do targeted rollback?
tess: saw the deploy-bot summary, logs show increased token truncation errors in streaming path. symptoms confined to dedicated instances in us-west-2. no customer-facing incidents reported yet.
deploy-bot: [automated alert] 2001234520 - metric: inference_errors +2.1% (p50), scope: dedicated/us-west-2, rollout: 10% traffic, suggested actions: notify-eng, consider partial traffic pin or rollback.
jordan: +1 for partial rollback to previous variant for US-WEST-2 only. keep hosted and other regions serving redwood-v2-custom. we can avoid full revert.
priya: If we do partial rollback, we need to pin the version and adjust routing policy. Also update release notes + customers on dedicated contracts. I'll draft a short comms.
sam (oncall): I can run the rollback steps and monitor. Do we have a runbook for partial traffic pin?
alex: yes — runbook section 4.2 (traffic-split -> pin). command: `rdwctl route update --pool us-west-2 --model redwood-v2-custom@2026-03-17-1 --pin true --traffic 0` (dry run first).
tess: Double-check KV cache compatibility; the regression looked like streaming truncations where kv serialization changed. If we switch back, we may need to clear cache for those instances. command: `rdwctl cache flush --pool us-west-2 --model redwood-v2-custom`
jordan: timeline: pause canary now, pin older variant, clear cache, then resume canary at 5% for 30m. If metrics stable, resume rollout. If not, full revert.
priya: Comms: short note to Dedicated customers in us-west-2 identifying possible transient truncation, we are rolling back model variant for that pool, ETA 15m, no expected data loss. I'll ping account teams.
sam (oncall): executing pinned rollback step 1 (dry-run) now. will post progress.
sam (oncall): dry-run OK. applying pin -> `rdwctl route patch --pool us-west-2 --pin-to redwood-v2-custom@2026-02-28-3`
sam (oncall): pin applied. flushing KV caches (started). monitoring p50/p95 and error-rate.
deploy-bot: [info] 2001234578 - rollback executed by sam. traffic for us-west-2 pinned to redwood-v2-custom@2026-02-28-3, previous canary halted.
tess: seeing p50 error back to baseline within 3 minutes. p95 also improved. good sign.
ajex: (typo) meant alex: nice. sam, please capture exact commands and add to the runbook notes + timestamp.
sam (oncall): noted. added snippet to runbook and created ticket REL-1427 to follow-up on root cause and regression test.
priya: sent customer comms to impacted Dedicated accounts and cc'ed acct leads. included temporary workaround and SLA note.
jordan: plan: after 1h stable, we'll re-run canary with a smaller patch that reverts streaming patch only. keep safety knob to auto-revert on >1% error increase.
tess: also adding a post-deploy test in CI that runs a short streaming serialization smoke test against a staging dedicated pool.
alex: thanks everyone — no need for company-wide comms. leaving thread open for 1h for monitoring updates. :thumbsup:
